* Support Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD deployments.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts.

description:

Full time**Type Of Hire :**

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Informix DBA with Postgres**


Every day at FIS, innovators, problem solvers and changemakers work together to create technology that advances the world of finance. We embrace new ideas, challenge what's possible and empower our teams to make a lasting impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of fintech, unlock your next chapter with FIS.

 **About the role**


Informix \& Postgres Database Administrator to manage, maintain, monitor, and optimize IBM Informix \& Postgres database environments supporting critical business applications. Responsible for database installation, configuration, performance tuning, backup and recovery, security compliance, high availability, disaster recovery, and production support activities

 **Your key responsibilities**

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM Informix \& Postgres database environments. Create and manage databases, storage structures, dbspaces, users, roles, and privileges. Perform database migrations, refreshes, and environment provisioning.
* Ensure database availability, reliability, and operational stability. Performance Management.Monitor database health and performance using standard monitoring tools. Analyze and resolve performance bottlenecks involving SQL, storage, memory, and I/O.
* Optimise database configurations for maximum efficiency and throughput. Perform capacity planning and growth forecasting. Backup and Recovery . Develop and maintain backup and recovery strategies. Execute and validate database backup schedules.
* Perform database recovery testing and disaster recovery exercises. Support business continuity and resilience requirements. High Availability \& Disaster Recovery.Implement and support Informix High\-Availability Data Replication (HDR), Shared Disk Secondary (SDS), and Remote Standalone Secondary (RSS) environments.
* Participate in disaster recovery planning and testing activities. Ensure recovery objectives are achieved according to business requirements. Provide 24x7 on\-call support as required.

 **What you bring**

 **Required qualifications**

  

* 12 to years of Database Administration experience. 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with IBM Informix (11\.x/12\.x/14\.x preferred) and PostgreSQL (v9\.x to v13\.x and EDB Postgres Advanced Server v9\.x to v13\.x) .
* Strong knowledge of: Informix \& Postgres Architecture, HDR, SDS, RSS replication technologies
* Plan, install, and configure PostgreSQL database systems (i.e. PostgreSQL v9\.x to v13\.x and EDB Postgres Advanced Server v9\.x to v13\.x) that meet business objectives and the needs of end\-users. Plan and carry out the upgrade and migration of databases. Develop, implement, and test database backup and recovery plans. Manage database and data security by controlling access to data through authentication, authorization, and auditing.
* Backup and recovery utilities. SQL tuning and performance optimization.Database security and auditing. Linux/Unix administration.Shell scripting (Bash/KornShell)

 **Preferred qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools.
* Familiarity with Informatics, ETL, or middleware technologies.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI).
* Experience with Ansible, Python, or automation frameworks.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management.

 **What we offer you****:**

  

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

**We offer:**

* Internal career growth opportunities
* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development
* Resources to contribute to your community

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. description:

**Location:** Remote
  
**India Reports to:** Vice President, Observability The person needs to work in US overlapping timings (5 PM to 2 AM).
  
  

**Job Summary:**  

A Senior Consultant, ServiceNow specializes in IT Service Management (ITSM), Customer Service Management (CSM), and Configuration Management Database (CMDB). This role involves leading implementations, optimizing processes, and ensuring platform stability while aligning with ITIL best practices.
  
The consultant will work closely with stakeholders to deliver high\-quality ServiceNow solutions that enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.

* Design, configure, and implement ServiceNow ITSM and CSM modules.
* Build and maintain CMDB structure, relationships, and integrations.
* Develop workflows, business rules, and automation scripts.
* Implement Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management processes.
* Align ITSM workflows with ITIL best practices.
* Configure case management, portals, and customer workflows.
* Integrate CSM with external systems for seamless customer experience.
* Implement Discovery and Service Mapping for accurate CI population.
* Perform platform upgrades, patches, and ensure compliance with ServiceNow standards.
* Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues proactively.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:**  

* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with ServiceNow implementation and administration.
* Strong expertise in ITSM, CSM, and CMDB modules.
* Proficiency in scripting (JavaScript, Glide) and integrations (REST, SOAP, APIs).
* Knowledge of ITIL framework and best practices.
* Excellent communication and client\-facing skills.


**Education and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (ITSM, CSM).
* ITIL Foundation Certification
